phrases.latin: In mūsēō, quod prope ruīnās est, rēs vīdērunt quās Rōmānī relīquerant
phrases.english: In the museum, which is near the ruins, they saw things the Romans had left behind
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

phrases.english: they bought entrance tickets at the entrance
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 174.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
